title: People (leader, personas, memory keepers, crowd)

other.name: MakeHuman system assets (body, skins, eyes, eyebrows, hair, clothes, shoes, proxy meshes, cmu_mb skeleton and weights)
other.author: the MakeHuman team (Data Collection AB, Joel Palmius, Jonas Hauquier)
other.use: every person; made with the MPFB add-on (GPL, used only as a tool, not shipped), bodies reduced to the low-poly game proxies, garments decimated, outfits baked into one texture

other.name: CMU Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database, BVH conversion by Bruce Hahne (2010)
other.author: Carnegie Mellon University
other.licence: free for research and commercial use (raw files not redistributed here)
other.use: the motions, retargeted and baked into each GLB: 77_02 standing (idle), 08_01 walk, 18_08 conversation with hand gestures (talk), 13_27 direct traffic and point (point), 79_69 very happy (cheer). The data used in this project was obtained from mocap.cs.cmu.edu; the database was created with funding from NSF EIA-0196217

made_here: The retargeting and the per-frame pose check (art/v2/insan/motion.py, build.py), the smoothed shoulder weights, outfit atlases, hair tints, garment recolours and the in-place, looping versions of the clips.
